title: Adaptive prefill circuit-breaker to stabilize FlashAttention v2/v3 kernel handoffs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Intermittent latency regressions observed during decoder startup when the runtime switches between FlashAttention v2 and v3 kernels. Implement an adaptive circuit-breaker that detects unstable handoffs during prefill and forces conservative kernel choices or short-term decode throttling. Goal: eliminate p95 spikes during bursty prefill traffic without sacrificing steady-state throughput.
